ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Process Hacker Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of Process Hacker based on binary metadata information (Image, Hash, Imphash, etc).
Process Hacker is a tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level options.
Threat actors abused older vulnerable versions to manipulate system processes.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\ProcessHacker\\_.*") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ProcessHacker\\\.exe$") OR (process_original_file_name = "ProcessHacker\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "Process\ Hacker") OR process_description = "Process\ Hacker" OR process_product = "Process\ Hacker" OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=68F9B52895F4D34E74112F3129B3B00D.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=B365AF317AE730A67C936F21432B9C71.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=A0BDFAC3CE1880B32FF9B696458327CE352E3B1D.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=C5E2018BF7C0F314FED4FD7FE7E69FA2E648359E.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=D4A0FE56316A2C45B9BA9AC1005363309A3EDC7ACF9E4DF64D326A0FF273E80F.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=BD2C2CF0631D881ED382817AFCCE2B093F4E412FFB170A719E2762F250ABFEA4.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=3695333C60DEDECDCAFF1590409AA462.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=04DE0AD9C37EB7BD52043D2ECAC958DF.*")))
